messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Arrow-key navigation is restored in [Board.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Board.tsx): unmodified arrows move one card within the same row or column and stop at board edges. Focus uses nearest-alignment scrolling through [use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts). Enter and Space still use native button activation, and modified keys are left to the browser.

I did not run tests.
